messages:
maria: quick heads-up — the cost heatmap shows negative cache savings for tenant 'acme' over last 24h. screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/abc123.png
ajay: ah, saw that too. can you paste the exact row/filters?
maria: filtered -> model: gpt-small, route: /generate, window: 24h, tenant=acme
jon: did we change sampling recently? we pull sampled telemetry for heatmap to keep query fast
sasha: yup i bumped default sample_rate -> 0.02 last week for the global ingest (was 0.01)
cost-bot: alert: sampling-drift detected for bucket 'ingest-raw' (rate=0.02) — values may be biased
ajay: ok that would explain it. heatmap's savings calc is naive extrapolation from sample without bias correction
ajay: quick repro SQL

SELECT
  tenant_id,
  SUM(tokens)* (1/sample_rate) as est_tokens,
  SUM(cache_hits) * (1/sample_rate) as est_cache_hits
FROM telemetry.sampled_events
WHERE model='gpt-small' AND route='/generate' AND ts >= now() - interval '24h'
GROUP BY tenant_id;

jon: that scaling (1/sample_rate) is fine only if sampling is uniform across dimensions. it isn't — we had burst sampling for high token users
sasha: right — we selectively increase sample_rate for bursty tenants to keep visibility
maria: UX question — can we show a badge/tooltip on the heatmap that says "estimated from sampled telemetry (0.02)" and link to explainability modal? users are puzzled
ajay: agree. minimal fix = tooltip + small "recompute exact" action that kicks off a per-tenant job (async). API: POST /internal/costs/recompute?tenant=acme&window=24h
sasha: compute is nontrivial — we should restrict recompute to top N tenants or require opt-in. otherwise costs blow up :grimacing:
jon: alternate faster approach: store a per-tenant sampling-weight correction factor that we update nightly from full-agg job. heatmap uses corrected factor.
maria: short term -> tooltip + add "recompute exact" (rate-limited, admin-only). long term -> correction-factor pipeline (jon + sasha)
ajay: i'll open a ticket for the tooltip + button + audit log (low effort). can we also add an inline note in billing docs that heatmap is sampled? @sasha
sasha: yes, i'll update docs and put a guard on recompute. also will add metric to monitor recompute-costs
maria: thanks — resolves the user confusion for now. follow-ups: ENG-4391 (tooltip/button), ENG-4392 (correction-factor pipeline)
ajay: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
cost-bot: created ticket ENG-4391 and ENG-4392 (automated)
